methodologyNotes: Roster covers twelve harnesses (sport all-rounders through alpine/ice and bigwall/trad specialists) verified 2026-08-11 primarily against manufacturer product pages (Black Diamond, Petzl, Metolius, Wild Country, Misty Mountain Threadworks) where those pages were reachable, and against major climbing-specific retailers (Rock+Run UK, Bergfreunde) when the manufacturer's own site was a JavaScript-rendered shell that returned no product data to a non-browser fetch (this affected Edelrid, Mammut, Blue Ice, DMM, Arc'teryx and CAMP to varying degrees); belay_loop_kn is null for every product because no manufacturer or retailer source in this dataset publishes a kN breaking-strength figure for the belay loop on its consumer product page (only pass/fail EN 12277 / UIAA certification is stated), and padding_type is left null rather than guessed wherever no source described the waistbelt/leg-loop padding material. Two seed products were dropped after extensive verification attempts: Arc'teryx AR-395a could not be located on arcteryx.com (its harness-category page renders no product listings to a server-side fetch, and every guessed product-slug and third-party retailer URL tried returned 404, consistent with Arc'teryx having exited the hardgoods harness market) and CAMP Energy CR4 could not be located on camp.it, camp-usa.com (which now 301-redirects to CAMP's corporate page), or any of six UK/US climbing retailers checked - rather than fabricate a source URL for either, both were omitted, leaving twelve fully-verified products instead of fourteen. Edelrid Jay III is likewise absent from edelrid.com's current harness lineup (superseded by the Jay IV) and is sourced instead from Bergfreunde, a EU retailer whose listing marks it "no longer available" - retained because it is a real, well-documented discontinued product rather than a fabricated one, with priceUsd left null accordingly. Weight is reported for the size stated as "Medium" (or the closest equivalent) where a manufacturer gives a per-size table, converted to oz from grams where only grams were published (1 oz = 28.35 g); full per-size weight and waist ranges are noted in each product's provenance field. Three products (Mammut Ophir 3 Slide, Wild Country Session, Blue Ice Choucas Pro, DMM Renegade) had confirmed prices only in GBP or EUR with no US-market MSRP locatable in this pass; priceUsd is left null with the foreign-currency price recorded in priceNote rather than converted, per the no-guessing rule.

products.name: Black Diamond Momentum Harness (Men's)

specs.padding_type: CLPE (cross-linked polyethylene) foam, Dual Core Construction waistbelt
specs.haul_ice_clipper_slots: 1 rear haul loop; no ice clipper slots

products.provenance: Black Diamond's own product page confirms 350 g (~12.3 oz), four pressure-molded gear loops, trakFIT adjustable leg-loop risers, one rear haul loop, and a single stated waist range spanning XS-XXL (24-45 in / 61-114 cm) rather than a per-size table. Materials list (20% CLPE Foam among others) is the basis for the padding_type entry; no belay-loop kN figure is published.

products.name: Black Diamond Solution Harness (Men's)

specs.haul_ice_clipper_slots: Low-profile rear 5th loop usable for hauling; no ice clipper slots (a reviewer quoted on the page notes the lack of ice-clip provisions)

products.provenance: Black Diamond's own product page gives a per-size weight table (XXS 316 g / XS 334 g / S 366 g / M 378 g / L 410 g / XL 440 g); the M value (378 g = 13.3 oz) is used as the representative weight. Four large thermoformed gear loops plus a separate low-profile rear fifth loop are described; adjustable, releasable elastic risers confirmed. Waist range compiled from the per-size inch/cm table (XXS 22-25 in through XL 36-39 in).

products.name: Petzl Corax Harness

specs.padding_type: EVA foam waistbelt; fixed (non-adjustable) unpadded leg loops

products.provenance: Petzl's own product page confirms 2 rigid front + 2 flexible rear gear loops plus a separate rear accessory loop (accessory loop not counted toward gear_loops, matching Petzl's own terminology), weight of 470 g (Size 1) / 520 g (Size 2) - the smaller Size 1 figure (16.6 oz) is used as representative - and waist ranges of 65-96 cm (Size 1) and 76-107 cm (Size 2). Petzl's current lineup deliberately differentiates Corax (fixed, non-buckle leg loops) from Adjama (adjustable leg loops); no explicit adjustability statement appears on the Corax page itself, so this is inferred from Petzl's stated product-line positioning rather than an on-page claim. Materials list includes EVA; no belay-loop kN figure is published.

products.name: Petzl Sama Harness

specs.padding_type: EVA foam with polyurethane coating; elasticized (non-adjustable) leg loops
specs.haul_ice_clipper_slots: No built-in slots; compatible with the separately sold CARITOOL EVO ice-screw holder accessory

products.provenance: Petzl's own product page gives a per-size weight table (S 310 g / M 330 g / L 355 g / XL 375 g); the M value (330 g = 11.6 oz) is used as the representative weight. Four gear loops (2 front rigid + 2 rear flexible) plus a separate rear accessory loop confirmed; elasticized leg loops (not buckle-adjustable) confirmed. Certified CE EN 12277 type C / UIAA; no belay-loop kN figure is published.

products.name: Petzl Adjama Harness
products.priceNote: Current MSRP on petzl.com (US), same price across all four sizes

specs.padding_type: EVA foam, FRAME Technology construction for weight distribution
specs.haul_ice_clipper_slots: Not specified on the product page

products.provenance: Petzl's own product page states five gear loops (two large front, two flexible rear, one center rear) and a per-size weight table (S 370 g / M 385 g / L 410 g / XL 435 g); the M value (385 g = 13.6 oz) is used as representative. Adjustable leg loops with DOUBLEBACK buckles (46-66 cm range) explicitly confirmed - the harness's name and marketing emphasize adjustability as the key differentiator versus Corax/Sama. Certified CE EN 12277 type C / UIAA, 3-year guarantee; no belay-loop kN figure is published.

products.name: Edelrid Jay III Harness
products.priceNote: Discontinued - listed as "no longer available" on Bergfreunde (EU retailer); no live price found. Edelrid's current site no longer lists Jay III at all, having moved to the Jay IV as its replacement.

specs.padding_type: Moveable/repositionable hip pad (exact foam type not specified)
specs.haul_ice_clipper_slots: 1 ice clipper slot; 1 chalk bag loop
specs.intended_use: via ferrata, mountaineering, general rock climbing

products.provenance: CORRECTED FROM SEED: Jay III does not appear anywhere in Edelrid's current harnesses-shop listing on edelrid.com (which instead lists the successor Jay IV, confirmed present in a Rock+Run UK listing found during this research). The product is real but discontinued; specs (4 symmetrical gear loops, 1 ice clipper slot, 1 chalk bag loop, 395 g / 13.9 oz for size M, adjustable leg loops, Dyneema-reinforced tie-in point, bluesign-approved materials, moveable hip pad) are taken from Bergfreunde's listing, which explicitly marks the item as no longer available - retained here as the genuine (if discontinued) product rather than substituted with an unverified guess. Waist size range was not stated on the accessed page and is left null.

products.name: Mammut Ophir 3 Slide 2.0 Harness (Women's)
products.priceNote: GBP 53.95 (reduced from GBP 60.00) at Rock+Run (UK); no confirmed US-market MSRP located - mammut.com renders its harness product pages as a client-side app that returned no product data to a non-browser fetch.

specs.padding_type: Split webbing construction (foam type not specified)
specs.haul_ice_clipper_slots: 2 ice clipper slots; drop-seat rear haul point
specs.intended_use: sport climbing, gym climbing, via ferrata, mountaineering

products.provenance: mammut.com's own Ophir 3 Slide product pages could not be retrieved as product data (repeated fetches returned only site navigation/header markup, no specs), so this entry is sourced from Rock+Run, a major UK climbing retailer, which lists the current-generation Ophir 3 Slide 2.0 (women's fit): four rigid textile gear loops rated to 20 kg each, adjustable leg loops, drop-seat function, two ice clipper slots, 385 g (13.6 oz) at size Medium, and a per-size waist table (XS 61-71 cm through L 80-92 cm). Named as the 2.0 / women's-fit variant rather than plain "Ophir 3 Slide" since that is the specific SKU actually verified.

products.name: Metolius Safe Tech All Around Harness

specs.haul_ice_clipper_slots: 1 rear haul loop; ice clipper slots not specified on the product page

products.provenance: Metolius's own product page confirms four gear loops (two on the smallest XS size), a single patented buckle that adjusts both leg loop size and rise, dual belay loops, reinforced tie-in points, a rear haul loop, 19 oz (539 g) at size Medium, Made in USA, and CE/UIAA certification. Metolius is one of several suggested "Safe Tech" models (Comp, Waldo, Trad, All Around, Deluxe); "All Around" was selected as the closest match to the generic "Metolius Safe Tech" seed name. Waist size range, padding material, and belay-loop kN rating are not published on the accessed page and are left null rather than guessed.

products.name: Wild Country Session 2.0 Harness (Men's)
products.priceNote: EUR 95.00 on wildcountry.com (EU site); no confirmed US-market MSRP located.

specs.intended_use: sport, trad, alpine, and ice climbing

products.provenance: Wild Country's own EU product page gives a per-size weight table (S 395 g / M 426 g / L 447 g / XL 466 g); the M value (426 g = 15.0 oz) is used as representative. Descriptive copy on the page says "4 spacious rigid gear loops" but the page's own specification table lists 5.00 for every size, so the table value (5) is used as the more authoritative figure. Adjustable leg loops and 2 ice tool holder slots confirmed. Waist range compiled from the per-size cm table (S 71-79 through XL 94-102). Padding material and belay-loop kN rating are not stated on the page.

products.name: Blue Ice Choucas Pro Harness
products.priceNote: GBP 89.95 (reduced from GBP 100.00) at Rock+Run (UK); no confirmed US-market MSRP located - blue-ice.com's own product pages returned no retrievable content to a non-browser fetch.

specs.padding_type: Breathable mesh waist belt and leg loops; no separate foam padding layer
specs.haul_ice_clipper_slots: 4 ice-screw slots on the waist belt plus ice-screw retainer elastics on both leg loops; rear drop-seat/haul attachment loop
specs.intended_use: alpine climbing and mountaineering in winter conditions

products.provenance: blue-ice.com itself could not be retrieved as product content (repeated fetches returned an empty page body), so this entry is sourced from Rock+Run, a major UK climbing/alpine retailer. Four gear loops (two semi-molded), 131-163 g per-size weight table (XS-XL), with the Medium value (145 g = 5.1 oz) used as representative; materials listed as UHMW polyethylene, high-tenacity PES, aircraft-grade aluminum, acetal buckles - consistent with an ultralight alpine design and no foam padding layer. Leg loops are described as "patented openable" with quick-release buckles for use with crampons/skis, which is an on/off convenience feature rather than a size-adjustment feature typical of ultralight alpine harnesses, so adjustable_leg_loops is recorded as false (fixed size, quick-opening buckle) rather than true.

products.name: Misty Mountain Cadillac Quick Adjust Harness

specs.haul_ice_clipper_slots: 1 rear haul loop; 2 ice clipper slots for racking ice screws

products.provenance: Misty Mountain Threadworks' own product page confirms six gear loops ("four up and two down"), elastic leg hold-ups with a patented Quick Adjust buckle, integrated rear haul loop, two ice clipper slots, 3/16 in. LD 60 foam padding, UIAA certification, and a per-size weight table (XS 16.7 oz through XL 21.3 oz) - the MD value (18.8 oz) is used as representative. Waist range compiled from the page's XS (24-26 in) through XXXL (41-48 in) table, converted to a combined cm range. Belay-loop kN rating is not published on the page.

products.name: DMM Renegade 2 Harness
products.priceNote: GBP 64.50 (reduced from GBP 80.50) at Rock+Run (UK); no confirmed US-market MSRP located - dmmclimbing.com itself refused every connection attempt during this research.

specs.haul_ice_clipper_slots: 1 haul loop; holds up to 4 ice clippers

products.provenance: dmmclimbing.com connections were refused/reset on every attempt during this research, so this entry is sourced from Rock+Run, a major UK climbing retailer stocking the current DMM Renegade 2 (successor to the original Renegade named in the seed list, retained as the current version a 2026 buyer would actually find for sale). Seven gear loops (3 per side, 1 back), free-floating waist belt with Slide Lock buckles, adjustable low-profile leg loops, drop-seat capability, 415 g (14.6 oz) at size Medium, and per-size waist table (S 70-80 cm through XL 94-104 cm) confirmed. Padding material and belay-loop kN rating are not stated on the accessed page.
